answer: Nothing an answer earns is spendable until a fraud window elapses, and during that window peers post signed proofs against old answers; a proven copy claws back every descendant of the root it fed, in one cut. Claims get audited with the tide, after submission, not only at the moment of posting, so a hollow answer cannot graduate on a friendly epoch. Per identity the attacker escrows a bond sized to the whole window, non-poolable because clawback follows the vine to each key downstream: one proof zeroes a branch's pending balance. Skip escrow and copying costs nothing to expose.
